_rule: w = log2(1 + cost_h), cost_h = max(register v2 instance total x 5.4 h, the class RCA's h/month figure), shared equally among the metrics that guard one class. Rounds 1-9 span 2026-09-01..09-29 (~1 month), so the stock cost and the monthly RCA figure are on one scale. A metric that guards no register class gets the floor 1.0. log2 compresses costs known only to about 2x; sensitivity is reported at 0.5x and 2x per weight.
